item.title: Drill 2026-10-23: crackme (unsigned div quotient/remainder)
item.description:
# Crackme: find the input (Windows x64, arg in ecx)
``` mov eax, ecx xor edx, edx mov r8d, 13 div r8d cmp edx, 5 jne fail cmp eax, 1000 sete al movzx eax, al ret fail: xor eax, eax ret ```
Which value of `ecx` makes the function return 1? Give it in decimal.
--- ANSWER ---
**Answer:** `13005`
1. `div r8d` is unsigned: it divides `edx:eax` by r8d, so `edx` must be zeroed first (`xor edx, edx`). The quotient lands in `eax`, the remainder in `edx`. 2. The checks demand remainder 5 (`cmp edx, 5`) and quotient 1000 (`cmp eax, 1000`). 3. Invert the division: `ecx = quotient * 13 + remainder = 1000*13 + 5 = 13005`. It is the only solution, since quotient and remainder fix the dividend uniquely.
